name: Demon and Heart
source:
Demon and Heart is a short supernatural and romance visual novel.

Demon and Heart: Protoype follows a high school student who is ruthlessly bullied by his classmate, but one day, a girl fights and beats your aggressor. She then gives you a lottery ticket that says "you win a demon" and it's the start of a strange story of gods and demons.

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/DemonandHeart/260877]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
《恶魔与心》是一部简短的超自然浪漫视觉小说。

《恶魔与心：原型》讲述了一名高中生被同学无情地欺负的故事，但有一天，一名女孩与攻击者战斗并击败了他。然后她给了你一张彩票，上面写着“你赢得了恶魔”，这是一个奇怪的神与恶魔故事的开始。

[来自[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/DemonandHeart/260877]GameJolt[/url]]
